details: I was attempting to visit a few friends on VRchat earlier today, but it has been lagging on my computer most of the day today. I simply thought it was a connection issue on my computer since I play it through the VR app on my PC (I don't have a VR headset yet). But at one point, it froze up and asked me if I wanted to play through desktop mode or Steam. I tried switching to Steam, and then I had a popup where VRchat asked me to verify my birthdate, so I did and then when I got it back up and running, it totally reset my whole account status: my avatars and worlds I had collected in my favorites were GONE, and I was defaulted to the robot avatar once more; and when I'm in world none of my friends come up in the Social tab on the menu, so I cannot join them or invite them. I haven't been on VRChat very long but nearly everything I built up in the last month has been deleted, all but my current status and my friends on VR are still listed on my account homepage, but that is all. Everything else is gone and I need to figure out how this happened and how to get it all back.
title: My account crashed (is this a bug?)
